# Leakage demonstration (generated by `ontime.features.leakage_demo`)

Univariate ROC-AUC of three versions of the seller late-rate feature against `is_late`. Only the first is used by the model. A leaky version looks 'better' because it secretly sees outcomes the system could not have known - the gap is the size of the lie.

| variant                                    |   auc_train |   auc_validation |   auc_test |
|:-------------------------------------------|------------:|-----------------:|-----------:|
| safe (delivered before t0)                 |      0.5534 |           0.507  |     0.5196 |
| leaky: approved before t0, outcome ignored |      0.5965 |           0.5747 |     0.5565 |
| leaky: whole dataset excluding self        |      0.6148 |           0.6022 |     0.5728 |
